text.en: Clients consistently commend the team at Uddingston for their kindness, attentiveness, and comforting manner. Longstanding pet owners highlight that both the vets and receptionists take time to listen, provide reassuring advice, and maintain a friendly atmosphere. Reviewers appreciate being treated like family during both routine visits and difficult end-of-life care.

Reviewers frequently praise the veterinary surgeons and nurses for treating their dogs and cats with exceptional tenderness and dignity. Pet owners note that nervous and unwell animals are kept calm and comfortable throughout consultations and procedures. Even wildlife rescuers mention that staff willingly examine injured animals with genuine compassion.

Pet owners report excellent medical outcomes for complex conditions, eye surgeries, and routine check-ups. Clients describe noticeable improvements in their pets' well-being after tailored medication changes and clear diagnostic advice. Reviewers express strong trust in the practice when managing ongoing chronic illnesses and difficult operations.

q.en: How do clients describe the care for nervous pets?

a.en: Owners emphasize that staff take time to settle anxious pets gently and provide a dedicated quiet area for cats.

q.en: Are the staff supportive during difficult end-of-life care?

a.en: Yes, multiple reviewers highlight the compassion and dignity shown by the team when caring for pets at the end of their lives.

q.en: How do reviewers view treatment costs at the practice?

a.en: While several clients appreciate the high level of medical expertise, a few reviewers feel that dental procedures and prescription medications are pricey.

q.en: Can owners receive advice over the phone?

a.en: Yes, clients report receiving practical and sound guidance from receptionists and nurses when phoning with health questions.
